summary: @servicetitan/document-title ships a Bun-runtime install-time dropper for an obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a React document-title component but declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that at `npm install` time downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts the `bun` binary, chmods it to 0755, and execFileSyncs it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~711 KB obfuscator.io-style scrambled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, WV8StW/hc1jfK9 decoder with a large shuffled numeric/string array) that is not human-readable and can only be executed by the freshly downloaded Bun runtime. The React entry (`dist/index.js`) is benign cover; the alternate-runtime staging exists to run the opaque bundle outside the reach of Node-based scanning. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` scope but the shipped install behavior is unrelated to ServiceTitan's documented OSS, consistent with account compromise or scope impersonation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
